derivations.quote: Fix the ground-set size $h=100$ and let $v=\binom h3=161700$ be the number of three-element subsets of $[h]$
Set $N=v^3=4227952113000000$ for the size of each data bank, and $m=h^3=1000000$ for the label-space dimension used later.
Three stages run $v^2$ invocations with own scratch wires, so there are $I=3v^2=78440670000$ invocations.
two triples $S,S'$ are neighbours when $|S\cap S'|=1$
the neighbours of a triple are the distinct triples with even intersection (zero or two)
The net change of $y$ is $(\mathcal J\mathcal V+\mathcal R\mathcal G)x$ and is independent of $\sigma,\gamma$; by the cancellations above it is $y\gets y+x$.
A forward invocation $X\to Y$ at stage 1, the inverse schedule $Y\to X$ at stage 2 and a forward invocation $X\to Y$ at stage 3 give
A fixed triple has $z_{\rm b}=3\binom{97}{2}=13968$ neighbours in the bit construction
It has $z_{\rm c}=\binom{97}{3}+3\cdot97=147731$ neighbours in the complex construction (intersection zero plus intersection two).
There are $c_{\rm b}=100$ central wires per invocation in the bit network and $c_{\rm c}=101$ in the complex one.
The bit network has $W_{\rm b}=2N+I(vz_{\rm b}+c_{\rm b})=177176569091445000000$ wires
The complex network has $W_{\rm c}=2N+I(vz_{\rm c}+c_{\rm c})=1873807244643542670000$ wires; all these numbers are fixed, independent of the input length.

symbols.name: ground-set size

symbols.meaning: The set of three-element subsets of [h].
symbols.quote: and let $\mathcal T$ be the set of these subsets

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of [h], indexing a value in a bank.
symbols.quote: Fixing two coordinates of $a$ leaves values $x_S,y_S$ indexed by triples $S\in\mathcal T$; $x$ and $y$ denote the vectors of all $x_S$ and all $y_S$.

symbols.name: source vector
symbols.meaning: The vector of all values x_S.
symbols.quote: Fixing two coordinates of $a$ leaves values $x_S,y_S$ indexed by triples $S\in\mathcal T$; $x$ and $y$ denote the vectors of all $x_S$ and all $y_S$.

symbols.name: target vector
symbols.meaning: The vector of all values y_S.
symbols.quote: Fixing two coordinates of $a$ leaves values $x_S,y_S$ indexed by triples $S\in\mathcal T$; $x$ and $y$ denote the vectors of all $x_S$ and all $y_S$.

symbols.name: other triple
symbols.meaning: A second triple, the index of a source value x_{S'}.
symbols.quote: Through central wires $C_i$, $i\in[h]$, gather adds $\sum_{S'\ni i}x_{S'}$ to $C_i$, with $S'$ another triple, and scatter adds $\sum_{i\in S}C_i$ to $y_S$.

symbols.name: bank index
symbols.meaning: The index of a value in a data bank, a triple of triples.
symbols.quote: Banks $X_a,Y_a$ are indexed by $a\in\mathcal T^3$, a triple of triples.

symbols.name: side scratch vector
symbols.meaning: The initial values of the side scratch wires.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma,\gamma$ be the initial side and central scratch vectors; $\mathcal V,\mathcal G,\mathcal J,\mathcal R$ are the copy, gather, injection and scatter maps.

relations.quote: In the complex construction, the network has scalars in $\mathbb Z[i,1/2]$, the Gaussian integers over powers of two of [Fixed-point Gaussian dyadic records](fixed-point.md), and the neighbours of a triple are the distinct triples with even intersection (zero or two).
